# fieldpro-nextjs

> Open-source technician app (/tech) and customer portal (/portal) for fieldpro, a field service
> management system on Frappe and ERPNext v16. Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript and Tailwind
> CSS, MIT license. The technician app signs in with a one-time code and an API token and works
> offline through an outbox with cursor sync; the portal uses a Frappe session cookie with CSRF.
> It is the code built in UPEO Academy's course "ERPNext as a Platform".

It needs the fieldpro-frappe backend. All backend calls go through `src/lib/api.ts`; response
types in `src/lib/types.ts` mirror the backend's API shapes. Next.js proxies `/api` and
`/socket.io` to Frappe so the browser stays on one origin.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): features, quick start, backend communication, offline sync, structure
